bullets: 【Universal Compatibility】: This table desk grip mount is designed to accommodate most smartphones. It features four clamps that securely hold your device in place, ensuring a stable and strong grip. Additionally, protective rubber components gently cradle your cell phone, keeping it safe.

【Security and Adjustability】: The four claws come equipped with anti-slip and anti-shock rubber cushions to keep your cell phone firmly secured. The long gooseneck is highly flexible and adjustable, allowing you to achieve the perfect viewing angle. The 360-degree swivel ball head enables both horizontal and vertical viewing.

【Easy Installation】: The robust metal clamp can be adjusted to fit surfaces up to 2.5 inches thick. This makes it ideal for attaching to desks, chairs, tables, beds, kitchen counters, and even in your car. Please remember to coil up the gooseneck when using heavy phones for added stability.

【Flexible Viewing】: The long wire is highly flexible and can be adjusted to your preferred viewing angle and distance. You can mount it to the side of a table, desk, door, and more using the sturdy metal spring clamp.

【Enhance Your Experience】: Use this mount to watch movies, videos, or listen to music in bed without having to hold your smartphone. It's also a valuable tool for business meetings, Zoom calls, or online lessons and courses.
